quote: Hudbay Minerals Inc. (“Hudbay” or the “Company”) (TSX, NYSE: HBM) announced it has received approval from the National Environmental Certification Service for Sustainable Investments in Perú (“SENACE”) to amend its environmental permit and further increase annual mill processing capacity at Constancia. … The amended permit increases the processing capacity of the Constancia mill to 34 million tonnes of ore per annum from the previously permitted 31 million tonnes per annum.
note: Opened Hudbay 2 Jul 2026 Constancia SENACE mill-throughput release.
